title: Preserve case-insensitive header lookup
prompt: Fix CaseInsensitiveDict in src/requests/structures.py, specifically __setitem__, so keys are compared case-insensitively while the latest spelling is preserved during iteration. Assign Content-Type and then content-type: the mapping must contain one item, all case variants must retrieve the latest value, and iteration must expose content-type. Keep the change focused and do not change tests.
test_command: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from requests.structures import CaseInsensitiveDict; headers = CaseInsensitiveDict(); headers['Content-Type'] = 'old'; headers['content-type'] = 'new'; assert len(headers) == 1; assert headers['CONTENT-TYPE'] == 'new'; assert list(headers) == ['content-type']"

source.mutation: CaseInsensitiveDict temporarily stores keys without lowercasing them.
